effects.label: Soft Veil
effects.description: A gentle overall blur that takes the edge off a hard frame.

effects.label: Deep Blur
effects.description: Heavy defocus — good for backgrounds, titles and reveals.

effects.label: Motion Streak
effects.description: Directional smear that reads as speed along one axis.

effects.label: Miniature
effects.description: Sharp band through the middle, soft above and below.

effects.label: Halo Bloom
effects.description: Light blooms out of the brightest parts of the picture.

effects.label: Angel Glow
effects.description: An even, diffuse glow across the whole frame.

effects.label: Highlight Bleed
effects.description: Warm halation ringing the highlights, the way film prints do.

effects.label: Overexposed
effects.description: Blown-out blooming light for a hard, hot look.

effects.label: Golden Leak
effects.description: Warm light spilling in from the frame edge.

effects.label: Window Streak
effects.description: A cooler, harder shaft of light raking across the shot.

effects.label: Anamorphic Star
effects.description: A streaked lens flare anchored to a bright source.

effects.label: Edge Fall
effects.description: Darkened corners that pull the eye to centre frame.

effects.label: Cinema Print
effects.description: Split-toned contrast curve — cool shadows, warm highlights.

effects.label: Teal & Amber
effects.description: The blockbuster complement — teal shadows against amber skin.

effects.label: Faded Stock
effects.description: Lifted blacks and rolled highlights, like aged print stock.

effects.label: Silver Halide
effects.description: Near-monochrome with a trace of colour left in.

effects.label: Polaroid 79
effects.description: Milky, warm-shifted instant film with soft blacks.

effects.label: Sun-Bleached
effects.description: Colour cooked out of the picture by years of daylight.

effects.label: Super Eight
effects.description: Amber-cast home-movie warmth. Stack with Cine Grain for the full look.

effects.label: Tape Warp
effects.description: Tracking error, chroma bleed and tape noise together.

effects.label: Camcorder 88
effects.description: Coarse interlaced lines with a slow vertical roll.

effects.label: Signal Dropout
effects.description: Horizontal streaks where the tape loses the signal.

effects.label: CRT Lines
effects.description: Fine, stable phosphor lines like a studio monitor.

effects.label: Block Shift
effects.description: Rectangular regions tear sideways out of position.

effects.label: Data Smear
effects.description: Compression artefacts dragged forward through time.

effects.label: Pixel Drift
effects.description: Bright pixels bleed along rows in sorted runs.

effects.label: Hard Corrupt
effects.description: Violent, fast corruption for hard cuts and impacts.

effects.label: Scan Tear
effects.description: Wide, slow horizontal tears across the whole frame.

effects.label: Impact Shake
effects.description: A sharp camera hit — lands beat changes and cuts.

effects.label: Handheld
effects.description: Subtle organic drift that makes a locked-off shot breathe.

effects.label: Earthquake
effects.description: Heavy sustained shaking with rotation.

effects.label: Rotor Jitter
effects.description: Fast rotational vibration, more twist than travel.

effects.label: Punch In
effects.description: Quick scale-up and release to emphasise a moment.

effects.label: Slam Zoom
effects.description: Aggressive snap zoom for hard emphasis.

effects.label: Whip Across
effects.description: A blurred lateral throw — pairs with a cut for a whip transition.

effects.label: Speed Rush
effects.description: Radial streaks rushing out from centre frame.

effects.label: Prism Edge
effects.description: Colour fringing that grows toward the frame edges.

effects.label: RGB Tear
effects.description: Red, green and blue pulled apart along one axis.

effects.label: Colour Fringe
effects.description: Barely-there aberration for subtle lens realism.

effects.label: Daydream
effects.description: Soft bloom over a sharp core — flattering and hazy.

effects.label: Milk Glass
effects.description: Heavier diffusion, like shooting through frosted glass.

effects.label: Bloom Haze
effects.description: Wide, low glow that lifts the whole image gently.

effects.label: Ripple Tide
effects.description: Rolling waves travelling across the picture.

effects.label: Heat Haze
effects.description: Fine shimmering distortion like hot air over tarmac.

effects.label: Barrel Push
effects.description: Bulges the centre outward for a pressurised look.

effects.label: Mosaic Block
effects.description: Quantises the frame into flat colour cells.

effects.label: Chunky Pixel
effects.description: Very large cells for an 8-bit, low-resolution read.

effects.label: Newsprint
effects.description: Dot-screen halftone like a printed newspaper.

effects.label: Retro Dither
effects.description: Ordered dithering down to a few colour levels.

effects.label: Cine Grain
effects.description: Fine animated grain that gives digital footage some tooth.

effects.label: Heavy Grain
effects.description: Coarse, pushed-stock grain for a gritty look.

effects.label: Dust & Scratch
effects.description: Specks and vertical scratches like a worn print.

effects.label: Archive Wear
effects.description: Badly-kept archive footage — heavy dirt and damage.

effects.label: Neon Trace
effects.description: Contours lit up in saturated neon over a dark frame.

effects.label: Club Strobe
effects.description: Alternating colour washes on a steady beat.

effects.label: Laser Edge
effects.description: Thin, intense green edge light like a scanning laser.

effects.label: Rave Pulse
effects.description: Fast, high-contrast colour flashing.

effects.label: Poster Print
effects.description: Flattens tones into bold poster bands.

effects.label: Ink Sketch
effects.description: Renders the frame as pen-and-ink line work.

effects.label: Cel Shade
effects.description: Three-tone flat shading for an animated-cel read.

effects.label: Edge Light
effects.description: Traces contours and lights them over the original.

effects.label: Contour Glow
effects.description: Thick, dominant outlines that read almost graphic.

effects.label: Fisheye Wide
effects.description: Ultra-wide lens curvature bowing the frame outward.

effects.label: Bubble Lens
effects.description: Extreme spherical warp — the frame becomes a bubble.

effects.label: Lens Pinch
effects.description: Pulls the centre inward for a concave, pinched frame.

effects.label: White Flash
effects.description: Rhythmic white blowouts — great on a cut or a beat.

effects.label: Camera Pop
effects.description: Short, hard flashes like a burst of stills photography.

effects.label: Bulb Flicker
effects.description: Irregular brightness wobble like a failing bulb.

effects.label: Mirror Split
effects.description: Reflects one half of the frame across the centre.

effects.label: Vertical Mirror
effects.description: Reflects top over bottom for a waterline effect.

effects.label: Kaleidoscope
effects.description: Folds the frame into radial mirrored wedges.

effects.label: Prism Fold
effects.description: Many fine wedges for a dense, jewel-like fold.
